description: For every ZFC set A, its Scott cardinal is nonempty, and its elements are exactly the sets equinumerous with A having the least attainable rank.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.scottCardinal_spec.{u} (A : ZFSet.{u}) :
  (∃ B, B ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.scottCardinal A) ∧
    (∀ (B : ZFSet.{u}),
        B ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.scottCardinal A ↔
          B.rank = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.scottRank A ∧ Nonempty (↥B ≃ ↥A)) ∧
      ∀ (B : ZFSet.{u}), Nonempty (↥B ≃ ↥A) → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.scottRank A ≤ B.rank
